# Third-Party Notice DOX

## Purpose

- Own repository-retained license notices for externally sourced native components.

## Local Contracts

- Preserve notices verbatim and keep each notice beside the dependency it covers.
- Packaging may copy these notices, but dependency source and version ownership remains in Go modules or the relevant vendored source directory.

## Child DOX Index

Direct child DOX files:

| Child | Scope |
| --- | --- |
| [onnxruntime/AGENTS.md](onnxruntime/AGENTS.md) | ONNX Runtime license notice. |
| [pion-opus/AGENTS.md](pion-opus/AGENTS.md) | Pion Opus license notice. |
